messages:
Alex P.: Heads-up — I'm out this weekend (public holiday) and I just noticed we have an APAC overnight coverage gap 2026-03-14 00:00–08:00 UTC. Can someone pick up primary or do a swap? There's a low-risk deploy slated Monday morning but I'd prefer explicit primary/secondary for the window.

Maria G.: I can cover part of that window (01:00–05:00 UTC) if Samir can take the late night tilt. @Samir? :wave:

Samir: I can do 05:00–09:00 UTC (so I overlap 1h with Maria). Not ideal earlier than 05 since I have a family thing but I can be reachable. I'll be secondary if Maria wants primary.

Alex P.: Thanks both. Main asks: 1) who is primary (handles pages) 2) who is secondary (backup + escalations) 3) confirm runbook pointers for deploy rollback and api-rate issues. Also add short checklist for handoff.

Ira K.: If Maria is primary for 01–05 and Samir covers 05–09, we still have 00–01 UTC uncovered. Anyone for that first hour? I can cover 00–01 as a temporary emergency fill but prefer to be secondary for rollback ops.

Maria G.: I can shift earlier to 00:30–05:00 if that helps (shorter sleep but fine one-off). So proposed schedule: Maria primary 00:30–05:00, Ira secondary 00:00–02:00, Samir primary 05:00–09:00 (handoff 05:00–06:00 overlap).

Alex P.: That works. Can someone confirm with an actual on-call handoff command so the rota reflects it? Also remind folks: customer-impact is low right now but Monday deploy touches routing; follow runbook 'deploy-rollback-v2' if we see increased 5xx.

incident-bot: /oncall handoff --from "Alex P." --to "Maria G." --role primary --start 1769894400 --end 1769916000

Maria G.: I ran the handoff command above and got a success message from the bot. :thumbsup:

Samir: I'll run my handoff at 05:00 UTC: /oncall handoff --from "Maria G." --to "Samir" --role primary --start 1769916000 --end 1769930400

Ira K.: Quick runbook snippets below (copy/paste when paging):

```
1) Check pager: https://status.redwood-inference.internal/pager
2) If API 5xx spike: run queries on /metrics?window=5m and check lb_error_rate (>2% = urgent)
3) To roll back deploy: kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/realtime-api --to-revision=<last-known-good>
4) If clients impacted, trigger incident-bot: /incident create --sev=2 --summary "realtime-api 5xx spike" --owner <primary>
```

Maria G.: Also adding a short handoff checklist: 1) confirm primary/secondary in rota 2) verify alert thresholds 3) ensure access to KMS keys + logs 4) set a slack status + calendar block. I'll set a status and a 4h focus window.

Alex P.: Great. Tagging for records: @oncall rotation updated, schedule set. Thanks everyone for the quick cover. If something changes ping here and we'll re-run the handoff.

Samir: noted. I'll stay on-call and keep phone reachable.

Ira K.: I'll keep an eye on dashboards 00:00–02:00 UTC and will escalate to Samir if anything looks off.

Maria G.: setting status now. Good luck y'all. :coffee:

Alex P.: Closing the thread — schedule: Maria primary 00:30–05:00 UTC, Ira secondary early 00:00–02:00 UTC, Samir primary 05:00–09:00 UTC. All handoffs executed via oncall bot.
